Stations

Individual stations: the top three teams each hold the full points; a new best that enters the top three takes the spot from the team in 3rd. Versus stations: one champion holds the points; a challenger who wins takes them. Ties: Air Straw splits equal counts by faster time; elsewhere the team that reached the result first ranks ahead, unless a tie-break is recorded.
